subject: Fast-track: model-affinity toggle + export hooks for OrionOne POC
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@orionone.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fast-track: model-affinity toggle + export hooks for OrionOne POC

Team — looping you all in on a time-sensitive ask from OrionOne (attached: Mutual Action Plan + POC requirements). Quick context: this is a 6–9 month POC that converts to a $2.1M ARR exec-sponsor deal if we meet their acceptance criteria. Right now the only blockers on their checklist are:

- Tenant-level model-affinity toggle (they need to pin a specific quantized model variant for strict repeatability)
- Streaming audit/export hooks (they want continuous export of inference traces + metadata into their S3 audit bucket with basic redaction)

They want a POC kickoff week of 4/25 and have stated these two items need to be demonstrable during the POC. Can Product/Eng confirm the minimal scoped deliverable we can commit to and an engineering ETA? If we can’t fully complete both, we need a pragmatic fallback we can ship within ~3 weeks (e.g., gateway-level routing flag + a nightly export job).

I recommend we triage this as a short-lived roadmap exception — commercial is willing to accept a partial feature with a documented caveat if engineering can deliver a working demo by 4/23. Please advise tradeoffs, security implications, and any required approvals (SRE/SEC).

Attachments: OrionOne_MutualActionPlan.xlsx, POC_Technical_Requirements.pdf

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@orionone.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fast-track: model-affinity toggle + export hooks for OrionOne POC

Thanks Marissa — good context. A few clarifying Qs and a proposed minimal scope below.

Questions:
1) When you say "pin a specific quantized model variant," do they need the runtime to enforce eviction/affinity across autoscaling events, or is config-level routing (route X -> model-v2-q4) sufficient for the POC?
2) For the audit export, are they ok with an append-only S3 drop (JSONL of traces + minimal PII redaction) or do they need streaming to their SIEM in near-real time?

Proposal for minimal committed scope (MVP):
- Model-affinity toggle: config flag at route level + a sticky routing key so traffic from their tenant routes to the chosen model variant; does not guarantee persistence across infra tears for the MVP (we can document caveats).
- Export hooks: deliver a push-to-S3 exporter that emits JSONL traces on completion and includes a simple redaction pass (strip user_input fields flagged in the attached PII list). Not real-time, but runs on a 5–10 minute cadence for the POC.

If Eng can confirm feasibility for this MVP, we can commit to ship a demo by 4/23 with a follow-up roadmap item to harden affinity across autoscaling in Q2. If Engineering prefers a different fall-back (e.g., gateway flag + nightly batch), call it out.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Product Manager, Enterprise
priom.das@redwoodinference.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@orionone.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fast-track: model-affinity toggle + export hooks for OrionOne POC

On Sun, Apr 4, 2027 at 11:03 AM Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Questions:
> 1) When you say "pin a specific quantized model variant," do they need the runtime to enforce eviction/affinity across autoscaling events, or is config-level routing (route X -> model-v2-q4) sufficient for the POC?
> 2) For the audit export, are they ok with an append-only S3 drop (JSONL of traces + minimal PII redaction) or do they need streaming to their SIEM in near-real time?

Short answer from Eng: we can deliver the MVP Priyom outlined, with the following constraints and estimates:

- Model-affinity toggle (MVP): implement as a route-level sticky config in the gateway + a lightweight lease in Redis to prefer the chosen worker pool. This gives the appearance of pinning for the POC but does not survive a full-scale cluster reassign; estimate ~6 engineer-days (2 backend, 1 infra) to demoable state.
- Export hooks (MVP): add a trace-emitter that writes JSONL to a customer-configured S3 prefix; include a configurable redaction script (we'll use the PII list in the attachment). Estimate ~8 engineer-days (2 backend, 1 infra).
- Security: SEC needs to sign off on the redaction approach. We'll also need an S3 bucket policy from OrionOne (least-privilege ARN).
- Risk: doing both in-parallel in 3 weeks is tight but possible if we allocate a focused sprint and deprioritize a couple of mid-sprint infra tasks. We can't guarantee SLA-level behavior until we harden affinity logic across scale (Q2 follow-up).

Fallback: if we can't get engineering capacity, we can demo a gateway-only routing flag + nightly export job (no Redis lease) in ~5 days, but it will have higher flakiness under load.

I'll block time on the eng roadmap meeting to propose a one-week focused slot if Sales wants to push for it. Need Sean or Marissa to confirm commercial tradeoffs (credit, acceptance caveats) so we can escalate.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@orionone.com>, orion-legal@orionone.com
Date: 2027-04-07T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fast-track: model-affinity toggle + export hooks for OrionOne POC

Thanks for the quick turn, team. High level: I agree this is strategically worth an exception — OrionOne has board-level visibility and the ARR math is clear. Two options for the CRO/APL team to approve (please pick one by EOD Friday so I can greenlight with Eng):

Option A (accelerate): dedicate a focused sprint next week (T1) to deliver the MVP Karthik described. Commercial will take a documented acceptance caveat stating affinity is "best-effort under autoscale" and get explicit SEC signoff on the redaction approach. In return we ask for a firm POC kickoff date and expedited legal signoff. We should offer a limited credit if we miss the demo date.

Option B (defer): do not accelerate; schedule the work for normal Q2 runway and present a robust solution that persists across autoscale. This preserves our Q2 priorities but risks losing deal momentum.

Action items:
- Marissa: confirm whether OrionOne accepts the acceptance caveat + their target demo date. (Marissa: can you get an S3 ARN from them?)
- Priyom: document the minimal acceptance criteria for the POC and add the follow-up ticket for autoscale-hardening in the roadmap backlog.
- Karthik/Jasmine: record an engineering estimate and specify what we must deprioritize to free the 2+3 engineer-days called out.

If Sales picks Option A, I'll escalate to the roadmap board and request the one-week slot. Marissa — can you confirm with Alicia today?

—Sean
